title: Sign-in device-flow: user_code expires before completion -> honest needs-sign-in holding
notes: Same honest-failure mapping as signin-denied-holding.json (S3), for the expires_in window lapsing (the ceremony's expires_in:900 with interval:5 gives ~180 poll attempts before an honest implementation should treat it as expired rather than polling forever). The wizard must offer a retry (new ceremony), never silently treat expiry as success.
